== choose sheet, collapsed ==

== choose sheet, advanced open ==
div.d-sheet [aria-describedby=d-sheet-5-d aria-labelledby=d-sheet-5-t aria-modal=true role=dialog]
  h2.d-sheet-title [tabindex=-1 id=d-sheet-5-t] "Choose Paladin Hammerdin?"
  p.d-sheet-line [id=d-sheet-5-d] "Your hero will spend every new skill and stat point following this build. You can change it later for gold: a respec now costs 1234 gold and refunds every point."
  div.d-sheet-adv
    button.d-sheet-adv-btn [aria-controls=d-sheet-5-adv aria-expanded=true type=button] "Advanced: pick a different plan"

          span.d-sheet-opt-why "The whole plan from level 30 up to level 90."

  div.d-sheet-row
    button.d-btn.d-sheet-cancel [type=button] "Cancel"
    button.d-btn.d-sheet-ok [data-variant=primary type=button] "Choose and lock"
